accessPatterns: create: TransactWriteItems Put IF attribute_not_exists(code) + owner counter ADD activeCount (IF activeCount < limit)
change / disable: UpdateItem IF ownerId = :o AND status = ACTIVE AND not expired
my links: Query byOwnerV2 (sk = createdAt#code) descending, keyset
_design.retention: purgeAtEpoch = (expiresAt or disabledAt) + 13 months; rows without expiry or disable have none, so a code is never recycled while old posts may carry it. Expand-only for deployed tables: add the index and attribute first, switch the TTL attribute last. expiresAtEpoch stays readable on legacy rows and is never written again.
_design.why: 100:1 reads, pure key lookups, billions of rows over years: no joins, uniform hash keys, on-demand capacity
